questions.evidence:
BUS BOARD: Bus A leaves school at eight ten and reaches the community garden at eight thirty-five. Bus B leaves at eight twenty and arrives at eight fifty. Both have enough seats for the volunteer group, and the fare is twenty dollars each way.

WORK PLAN: Volunteers must receive a ten-minute safety introduction before beginning. Planting takes forty minutes. Cleaning tools takes fifteen minutes afterward. The garden gate opens at eight thirty, and the group must catch a return bus leaving the garden at nine fifty.

MESSAGE: Please bring gloves and a filled water bottle. A late arrival cannot skip the introduction. Students who finish planting early must still wait for the group cleanup. The return driver will not wait because another group needs the bus later.

The students choose Bus A. On arrival, they start the introduction immediately. Their teacher sets a timer for each job and includes the cleanup in the plan. Each student brings forty dollars for transport and keeps lunch money separate.
